status: Implemented and verified against nine native batch cases, actual filesystem/HTTP source guards and the isolated GUI suite.

observed.widgets: The nine ordinary batch workflows retain both Quick Save filenames, directories, formats and disclosures. Completed-load cancellation resets source metadata and folders as specified in quick-save-cancellation-contract.json; later captured task cancellations retain the widgets.
observed.source: Ordinary batch attempts advance the current model filename, including failed loads. Completed-load cancellation clears it; captured later-task cancellations retain the current attempted file. Queue-only changes retain the preceding source path.
observed.protection: The statically traced Quick Save source-overwrite guard reads the current MainModel filename, independently of retained widget text. An old widget filename is not an authority for source protection.

implementation.owner: GuiEngine owns the current resolved source filename. Single-image commit, source reset and each completed batch-load attempt update this owner. QuickSave owns window fields only.
implementation.save: GuiEngine.quickSaveTarget combines the chosen widget target with the current source path. QuickSaveFile continues using its existing source comparison and pending-save ownership.
implementation.widgets: No batch-load notification is sent to QuickSave.sourceChanged; that method remains the single-image/reset widget event.

evidenceLimits: The frozen helper aborts on native modals; no native controls or dialogs were driven.
Raw clocks/durations are retained. Only those established timing fields are normalized for repeat comparison; all other state and exported SVG bytes match.
Seven cancellation cases are verified separately in quick-save-cancellation-contract.json. Overwrite-preflight skip and active-job shutdown remain outside the native Quick Save captures.
Native Quick Save write/error handlers were not executed. This scope combines observed source state with the prior static source-protection branch.
knownUnrelatedFailure: processing-batch-controls injects backgroundMode 2 through an internal setter; the verified public menu admits 0, 1 and 3. Its existing failing test and contract remain unchanged.

verification.knownFailure: processing-batch-controls internal setter 2 against public menu 0/1/3; unchanged.
